description: Phase 19 per-module coverage ratchet enforced by scripts/coverage-report.ps1. Inputs: merged coverlet.collector (XPlat Code Coverage, Cobertura) reports of Template.Unit.Tests, Template.Integration.Tests and Template.Functional.Tests. Minimums = floor(measured - 1) of the coverlet 10.1.0 baseline measured on 2026-10-12 (line and method data identical in three runs); minimumSources = measured source files after exclusions. Phase 21 (2026-10-14, owner-approved): Application minimumSources 41->40 and WebApi 32->31 after removing the dead ApiErrorResponse.cs and ApiResultFilterAttribute.cs, Application line raised 93->94 from the measured 95.12%. Raise the numbers when coverage improves; lowering one weakens the gate and needs explicit justification and approval.

exclusions.reason: EF Core scaffolded migrations, designers and model snapshots (generated, never hand-edited).
